BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to premature infants; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By December 1, 2010, the department ofhealth shall: (1) Examine and improve hospital discharge and followup careprocedures for premature infants born earlier than thirtyseven weeksgestational age to promote standardized and coordinated processes aspremature infants leave the hospital from either a level 1 well babynursery, level 2 step down or transitional nursery, or level 3 neonatalintensive care unit and transition to followup care by a health careprovider in the community; (2) Use guidance from the centers for medicare and medicaidservices' neonatal outcomes improvement project to implement programsto improve newborn outcomes, reduce newborn health costs, and establishongoing quality improvement for newborns; and (3) Report data regarding the incidence and cause ofrehospitalization in the first six months of life for infants born p. 1 HB 3074premature at earlier than thirtyseven weeks gestational age to theappropriate committees of the senate and house of representatives.
